ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters concentrated at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast irregular mottling and contiguous light-colored blobs localized on the distal 1/4 of both the left and right lobes; central fluke region is a solid low-intensity mask with minimal variance.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an approximate 85-degree angle and a depth roughly equivalent to 10-12% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered circular high-intensity clusters observed on the dark regions of the lobes, with a dense grouping of roughly 5-8 distinct points on the upper-right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light streaks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, irregular texture at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant wear or previous biological colonization/detachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive, asymmetrical 'web-like' pigmentation pattern localized on the trailing edge of the right fluke tip.
